title: American Orthodox Catholic Church demands FBI background checks
summary: Peter Levenda tells of American Orthodox Catholic Church demands FBI background checks, about 1965 at The Bronx, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then he starts demanding the other churches submit to a background check by the FBI to make sure that they're acceptable to him in the Bronx in New York.
his people were vetted by Jay Edgar Hoover himself.
tellings.difference: Says Hoover personally vetted Propheta's own priests and bishops, and dates it 1968-69 rather than 1965.
tellings.link_reason: The same arrangement as the story: Propheta's church and FBI or Hoover vetting of clergy in the Bronx.
